summary: Writes four caller-supplied integer parameters into four consecutive dword fields of a struct (offsets 0x14, 0x18, 0x1C, 0x20) and returns the fourth parameter (a4) as the function result. No guards or calls; straight-line thiscall writer.

operations.description: Store a2 into struct dword at offset 0x14 (this[5]).
Store a3 into struct dword at offset 0x18 (this[6]).
Store a4 into struct dword at offset 0x1C (this[7]).
Store a5 into struct dword at offset 0x20 (this[8]).
Return a4 as the function result; the same value was also stored at offset 0x1C.
